

Model name: Document
Snippets:

    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage; 
    protected static function booted()
    {
        // Delete the physical file when the record is permanently deleted
        static::forceDeleting(function ($document) {
            if ($document->document && Storage::disk('documents')->exists($document->document)) {
                Storage::disk('documents')->delete($document->document);
            }
        });
    }




    Model name: Profile
    Snippets:

        use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
        protected static function booted()
        {
            static::forceDeleting(function ($profile) {
                if ($profile->photo && Storage::disk('public')->exists($profile->photo)) {
                    Storage::disk('public')->delete($profile->photo);
                }
            });
        }
